passages.scripture: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home, they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.

lines.text: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum — Capernaum was a town by the Sea of Galilee where Jesus had taught before.
And the people heard that Jesus was home.
So the people gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room.
There was no more room, not even outside the door — the crowd filled the house and spilled outside the house.
Jesus spoke the word to them — this word is God's message, the good news that His kingdom has come near.

passages.scripture: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.

lines.text: Then a paralyzed man was brought to Jesus.
Four men carried the paralyzed man to Jesus.

passages.scripture: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.

lines.text: A crowd was in the way, so the four men could not bring the paralyzed man to Jesus.
The four men uncovered the roof above Jesus.
The four men made an opening through the roof.
The four men lowered the mat down through the opening.
The paralyzed man was lying on the mat.
